verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes its own integrations directory advertising over 130 native prebuilt integrations, and its bot docs mention running an existing Zulip bot. However, the evidence does not show an in-product app directory or marketplace where a team-admin can browse and install integrations. Nor does it document the admin install flow or permissions. missing for 10: documented in-app marketplace/one-click install flow for admins, admin permission controls for installing integrations, hands-on or independent corroboration of the install experience.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can install prebuilt integrations from an app directory or marketplace

citations.quote: You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
